description: Recommends weight‑losing and weight‑neutral medications as first‑ and second‑line agents for managing overweight/obese patients with type 2 diabetes. Triggers include when a clinician asks, 'Which diabetes medications will not worsen weight in this obese patient?' or 'Should I avoid sulfonylureas in this patient with T2DM and obesity due to weight gain risk?'
